The SEO Content Writer & Editor is responsible for developing, editing, and managing written content for a number of designated clients. This includes collaborating with SEO Leads on content strategy and planning, following internal content guidelines, and ensuring consistency, quality, and performance across all written materials. A key part of this role is editing and refining content to a high standard, and using AI tools to build faster, more efficient content workflows. 

Key ResponsibilitiesA. Content Strategy & Development
Collaborate on and execute key content strategies aligned with SEO and client goals.
Create high-quality, original, SEO-optimized content for websites, blogs, and landing pages.
Manage and update an editorial calendar to ensure consistent publishing schedules.
Work closely with your team lead and SEO Strategists to align written content with broader campaign goals.
Edit and proofread content to ensure accuracy, correct grammar, and a consistent brand voice before publishing.
Use AI tools to draft, research, and produce quality content, refined with human editing. (Experience with Claude, ChatGPT, and Perplexity preferred)
B. Content Management
Meet content production timelines and maintain quality control across deliverables.
Ensure brand voice, tone, and messaging are consistent across all platforms and for all clients.
Adjust and update content based on analytics and audience behavior insights.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (SEO, Paid Media, Client Management) to ensure content serves campaign goals.
C. SEO & Optimization
Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis to support SEO strategy.
Apply SEO best practices to all content, including keyword placement, formatting, and metadata.
Analyze content performance using analytics tools to make data-driven decisions for content optimization. (Experience with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console considered an asset)
3. Expected Outcomes
Consistent delivery of high-quality, engaging, and SEO-optimized content.
Increased organic traffic and improved SERP rankings for client and internal sites.
Effective coordination and scheduling of content tasks and deadlines.
Meet quality standards and timeline expectations.
Clearly communicate with your team about any challenges or support requests
Be responsive and available during work hours.
4. Requirements
Excellent written English with near-native fluency, strong grammar, spelling, and a keen eye for detail.
Proven experience writing and editing website content (not just blogs — landing pages, service pages, etc.)
SEO knowledge: keyword research, understanding analytics, and writing for both search engines and real readers.
Strong editing and proofreading skills: able to take a rough or AI-generated draft and make it polished and publish-ready.
Comfortable and creative with AI tools, with an interest in building better systems and workflows.

Note: Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a short editing and writing exercise.

Accenture es una empresa líder mundial de servicios profesionales, que ofrece una amplia gama de servicios y soluciones en estrategia, consultoría, digital, tecnología y operaciones. Nuestro principal propósito es colaborar con nuestros clientes, para que puedan convertirse en negocios de alto rendimiento. La posición tendrá un enfoque principal en la ejecución de campañas dentro del ecosistema Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen, Display y YouTube), así como apoyo en otras plataformas digitales como Meta Ads y TikTok Ads.

Implementar y optimizar campañas de Paid Media.

Monitorear KPIs y generar recomendaciones de mejora.

Apoyar iniciativas de SEO técnico y de contenido.

Validar configuraciones básicas de tracking y medición digital.

Colaborar en la definición de estructuras de atribución y análisis de resultados.

Elaborar reportes de desempeño y seguimiento de indicadores.

Identificar oportunidades para incrementar eficiencia y resultados de negocio.



La posición requiere un perfil analítico, orientado a resultados y con conocimientos en marketing digital, medición y optimización de campañas.

description:
About the job

Job Requisition ID #

26WD98585

Position Overview

Autodesk is looking for a Senior Manager to lead the Account-Based and Field Marketing (ABFM) team and accelerate growth for priority industry solutions in the Latin America (LATAM). This person will be part of the leadership team for the Americas geo-based Marketing team that generates demand for our platforms and solutions across key customer segments through account-based motions, field marketing, and partner marketing, with holistic plans that align to the Americas Sales priorities. The Senior Manager role is ideal for someone who thrives on transforming go-to-market priorities into regional marketing strategies and plans, and leading a team to overachievement against pipeline and revenue generation targets.

This role motivates and orchestrates relevant Marketing resources for the regions within Latin America. The Senior Manager directly oversees and supports Account-Based Marketing and Field Marketing Managers delivering marketing sourced impact of key programs and ABM clusters in Brazil and Mexico. The role also coordinates strategic coverage and action plans with Partner Marketing, Brand and Communications, other teams in Marketing and Sales.

The Senior Manager delivers strategic plans for the year for multi-channel demand generation, customer engagement, and pipeline acceleration initiatives; and ensures flexibility to adapt based on quarterly business results and insights. The successful candidate will work closely with LATAM Sales and Technical Sales leadership, Industry and Campaign Strategy, Governmental Affairs, Communications, Marketing Operations, Partner Marketing, and other ABFM teams within AMER Marketing to deliver scalable regional marketing programs aligned to geo priorities and customer buying journeys.

The right candidate is a hands-on team leader, combining strategic planning with operational oversight and support. The Senior Manager will be someone who thrives in a matrixed environment, and is driven to proactive collaboration in crafting programs, events, and other customer experiences that drive increasing amounts of account engagement and deliver measurable business outcomes.

Motivates ABFM team to create and manage multi-channel demand generation across digital campaigns, webinars, Autodesk and 3rd party live events, and emerging channels as appropriate, to drive account engagement and generate tangible pipeline

Collaborate with Partner Marketing, Campaign Development, Content Studio, Marketing Operations, and Analytics teams to improve execution, extend campaign coverage and customer reach, and strengthen pipeline visibility
Help scale successful programs by improving workflows, standardizing best practices, and supporting operational efficiency across geos, regions, and territories

8+ years of experience in B2B SaaS field marketing, demand generation, campaign orchestration, or account-based marketing

Strong collaboration, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with experience working effectively across Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Partner teams in a matrixed organization

Experience working with, and operational understanding of, marketing automation, CRM, intent, and engagement platforms such as 6sense, Salesforce, Marketo, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Allocadia, and AI-enabled marketing tools

description:
About the job

SOBRE EFEX




EFEX es una institución financiera regulada que opera el corredor de pagos entre México, Estados Unidos y el resto del mundo. Nuestros clientes son empresas que le pagan a proveedores en el extranjero, cobran a clientes fuera de México, administran tesorería en varias divisas o recibieron inversión extranjera.




Operamos cuatro líneas de negocio: transferencias internacionales, transferencias masivas, cobranza internacional en moneda local y cuentas empresariales multi-divisa. Enviamos pagos a más de 140 países, cobramos localmente en más de 24 y operamos en once divisas.




Estamos autorizados por la CNBV como transmisor de dinero y cumplimos con la regulación de FinCEN en Estados Unidos. Nos respaldan PayPal Ventures, Franklin Templeton, Floodgate, 500 Startups y Nido Ventures. Tenemos oficinas en Ciudad de México, Monterrey, Guadalajara, Querétaro, Tijuana y Palo Alto.




Lo que vendemos es simple de explicar: el nivel de sofisticación financiera de un corporativo grande, sin la complejidad de operar con varios bancos.




SOBRE EL PUESTO




Vas a ser el primer contacto de EFEX con empresas mexicanas de comercio exterior. Tu trabajo es encontrar a las que están perdiendo dinero en cada pago al extranjero, entender cómo operan hoy y llevarlas a una conversación con un especialista.




No cierras contratos en este puesto. Abres conversaciones con áreas de finanzas (que es la parte más difícil del ciclo comercial) y trabajas junto a un especialista que se encarga del cierre.




RESPONSABILIDADES




Contactar por teléfono a alrededor de 50 empresas al día. Los leads los provee el equipo de Growth: no inviertes tu tiempo construyendo listas.
Conversar con dueños de negocio, direcciones de finanzas, contraloría y tesorería para entender cómo pagan y cobran al extranjero hoy, y qué les cuesta.
Calificar la cuenta: identificar volumen real de pagos internacionales, divisas involucradas y fricción con su banco actual.
Usar herramientas de IA para investigar la cuenta antes de llamar, preparar el abordaje y dar seguimiento. Es parte del método de trabajo del equipo.
Agendar la junta y hacer el traspaso al especialista con el contexto completo.
Mantener el registro en el CRM al día.




PUEDE QUE ENCAJES SI




Tienes licenciatura, titulada o pasante, en finanzas, contaduría, derecho, relaciones internacionales, comercio internacional, economía, administración o carrera afín.
Has trabajado antes en empresas formales.
Tienes experiencia en ventas, o un gusto genuino por vender. Cualquiera de las dos funciona.
Te interesan los temas bancarios y de divisas. No necesitas dominarlos, pero sí tener curiosidad real por cómo una empresa mueve su dinero: tipo de cambio, tesorería, banca empresarial, comercio exterior.
Te sientes a gusto trabajando con IA. Si ya usas Claude, ChatGPT o Gemini, mejor. Si no, con disposición a aprenderlas es suficiente: aquí se usan a diario.
Estás cómodo con el teléfono y con el volumen. Este puesto es de llamadas todos los días.
Lees inglés a nivel intermedio o avanzado.
Trabajas con orden: registras, das seguimiento y no dejas cabos sueltos.
El "no" no te desarma. Vas a escuchar varios antes de cada "sí".




No pedimos experiencia previa en fintech ni en banca. Eso se aprende aquí.




SUMAN PUNTOS




Experiencia previa como SDR, en telemarketing, call center o cobranza.

Conocimiento de comercio exterior, aduanas, logística o banca empresarial.

Haber trabajado con HubSpot o cualquier otro CRM.




COMPENSACIÓN




Sueldo base de USD competitivo, según experiencia. El pago es en dólares.
Adicionalmente, comisión por cada cliente que llega a realizar su primera transferencia fondeada. La comisión escala con el tamaño de la cuenta y no tiene tope superior. No existe cuota mínima que alcanzar antes de cobrarla: se paga desde el primer cliente.




LOGÍSTICA




Ubicación: Ciudad de México, esquema híbrido.

Pago en dólares.

Jornada completa.




CÓMO APLICAR




Envía tu CV por mensaje directo en LinkedIn o aplica en la vacante. Las dos rutas llegan al mismo lugar.




Si quieres agregar contexto a tu postulación, cuéntanos en un párrafo cuál es la conversación más difícil que has tenido que iniciar con un desconocido y cómo la abriste. Es opcional, y lo leemos.




Te recomendamos aplicar aunque sientas que no cumples con todos los puntos de la lista. Preferimos conocerte y evaluarlo juntos.

description:
About the job

Propósito




Evalúa los Business Cases de las áreas para optimizar el presupuesto destinado a proyectos, asegurando que dichas iniciativas estén alineadas a los objetivos del banco, hacen sentido de negocio y son rentables financieramente.







Responsabilidades




• Promueve una cultura centrada en el cliente a fin de profundizar las relaciones con los clientes y aprovechar las amplias relaciones del Banco, así como sus sistemas y conocimientos.




• Analizar Business Case, Memorandos e Iniciativas mediante la verificación de que los costos e ingresos inherentes al proyecto hayan sido estimados razonablemente, asegurando que el nuevo proyecto genere ingresos o ahorros y que este alineado en términos de la política de facultades de gasto y si estos proyectos están dentro o fuera de presupuesto.




• Validar y analizar que el objetivo, alcance y propuesta de solución de cada requerimiento sea acorde a las estrategias establecidas por la institución. Analizar y validar los montos expresados dentro de los Cash Flow y P&L de cada requerimiento, validando cotizaciones de terceros y modelos de ingresos, ofreciendo asesoramiento al sponsor para formalizar sus propuestas. Gestionar los procesos de aprobación de las Nuevas Iniciativas




• Responsable de generar mensualmente la actualización de los KPIs estratégicos, es decir, los KPIs que se encuentran en la evaluación de los Directores Generales Adjuntos. Este reporte se presenta una vez al mes con el Director General y sus reportes directos. La métrica de éxito es presentarlo en la cuarta semana del mes en el Senior Management, que haya sido socializado con los DGAs previamente y que no se tengan errores en el llenado




• Responsable de dar visibilidad a los DGAs de su desempeño trimestralmente. El proceso se realiza recopilando los KPIs de cada DGA y comparando vs. la meta del año. La métrica de éxito es enviarlo a los DGA y DG en la cuarta semana una vez acabado el trimestre. Lidera el llenado de cuestionarios solicitados por reguladores. Específicamente la encuesta trimestral de Banco de México y la encuesta anual de la SHCP. La métrica de éxito es entregar en tiempo y sin errores. Realizar seguimiento semanal de los requerimientos en análisis y aprobados durante el año BNS




• Administrar y controlar el presupuesto de los Business Case, Memorándums e iniciativas aprobados durante el año BNS. Informes mensuales a Toronto sobre el estatus de costos e ingresos de los nuevos proyectos mayores a CAD $ 2.5MM y elaboración de seguimientos eventuales a Business Case solicitados por Toronto. Gestionar todas las actividades relativas al Plan de Continuidad de Negocio (BCP por sus siglas en inglés) del Área de Estrategia realizando el análisis de impacto al negocio y coordinando las visitas a sitio alterno y casos de incidencias




• Comprende la cultura de riesgo del Banco y cómo debe considerarse el apetito de riesgo en las actividades y decisiones diarias.










Requisitos







•Con una Licenciatura en áreas como: Actuaría, Administración, Contaduría Pública y Estrategia Financiera, Dirección Financiera, Economía, Matemáticas Aplicadas, Ingenierías en Negocios, Industrial y carreras afines.

•Con promedio acumulado mayor a 80 en sus estudios profesionales

•Excelente nivel de inglés (90%)

•Manejo de paquete básico de Microsoft (Excel y PowerPoint), deseable conocimiento en algún lenguaje de programación (SQL, R, Python)

•Deseable con experiencia previa en análisis de datos, ya sea en un empleo previo, prácticas profesionales o proyectos










En Scotiabank, valoramos las habilidades y experiencias únicas que cada persona aporta al banco y nos comprometemos a crear y mantener un entorno inclusivo y accesible para todos/as. 🏋️ Access to benefits (country dependent 🌎 )




Who We Are 




At Storm Ideas, we supercharge the digital presence of some of the biggest names in US TV and entertainment. Since 2008, our international team has delivered bold, forward-thinking solutions for globally recognised clients.




Whether we're building innovative products, producing high-impact social content, or designing smarter ways for our partners to work—we’re right at the cutting edge of creativity, technology, and automation.




Embracing Future-Facing Technology 




Emerging technologies like Artificial Intelligence present exciting opportunities for us and our clients. As the world adapts, we’re committed to safely exploring the potential advantages of AI, integrating it thoughtfully into our work where possible, and one day guiding our clients through new possibilities when they’re open and ready for them. By tapping into our creativity, expertise, and collaboration, we aim to embrace its potential together. Our vision relies on people who are curious about this technology and excited to take on this challenge!




RESPONSIBILITIES 




Storm Ideas partners with some of the world's most recognisable media and entertainment brands. Behind that work are planning processes, approvals, asset handoffs, reporting needs, stakeholder reviews, and internal systems that need to run cleanly.




As a Creative Operations Officer, you will help teams turn messy creative and operational processes into clear workflows, systems, documentation, and handoffs. This is not a generic coordinator role. The focus is reliable delivery: understanding how work really moves, structuring it clearly, building practical Airtable and lightweight workflow solutions, and helping people use them.




You do not need to come from a social media background. You do need to be comfortable learning new domains quickly, asking good questions, and using tools and AI to make your work clearer, faster, and easier to hand over.




What can you expect? 

Organize and manage your own work across briefs, tasks, priorities, and follow-ups, without needing every next step spelled out.
Deliver work cleanly, independently, and on time, with clear status updates.
Map messy processes, identify bottlenecks, and turn ambiguous briefs into clear next steps.
Use AI responsibly to speed up workflow mapping, documentation, QA, data cleanup, and automation support, while checking outputs carefully.
Clean up creative approval workflows so teams know what is planned, what is waiting for review, what is approved, and who owns the next action.
Structure work into sensible fields, statuses, ownership, handoffs, review points, and definitions of done.
Build Airtable bases, views, and interfaces for client teams, with supporting documentation that makes the workflow easy to use.
Improve lightweight systems in tools such as Airtable, spreadsheets, project management platforms, documentation tools, Slack or Teams workflows, and automation platforms.
Create clear documentation, SOPs, interface notes, handover materials, and client-ready explanations.
QA your own work before handoff, checking data, logic, copy, statuses, permissions, assumptions, and user experience.
Present process improvements in clear, non-technical language to internal teams and client stakeholders.
Collaborate with creative, social, client service, analytics, and technical colleagues to ship practical improvements.
Support workflows after launch by gathering feedback, fixing friction points, and improving adoption.




QUALIFICATIONS 




What's important to us: 

Experience taking ownership of workflows, processes, systems, or operational projects and making them clearer or more reliable.
Strong structured thinking: you can break a messy problem into users, inputs, outputs, statuses, handoffs, risks, and decisions.
Practical AI use in real work, improving workflow efficiency and measuring success with KPIs.
Reliable ownership of defined projects, including asking clarifying questions, communicating progress, and escalating early when something is blocked.
Excellent written communication and documentation skills.
Confidence with spreadsheets, structured data, project tools, and documentation tools.
Strong no/low-code and systems aptitude. Airtable experience is highly useful, and this role will suit someone who enjoys turning a rough workflow into a clean working process.
High attention to detail and a habit of checking work before it reaches other people.
Comfortable explaining systems, process changes, and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.
Adaptability and curiosity about new tools, especially where they make delivery cleaner or faster.




What’s nice to have: 

Experience with creative, content, social, campaign, approval, or asset workflows.
Experience building Airtable bases, interfaces, automations, or similar lightweight project management workflows.
Familiarity with tools such as Asana, Monday.com, Jira, Zapier, ChatGPT/Codex, Claude/Cowork, Slack, Teams, etc.
Basic familiarity with JavaScript, HTML, APIs, or scripting concepts.
Experience with change management- helping teams adopt a new process or tool without creating unnecessary complexity.




What It’s Like to Work Here




Cutting-Edge Tools & Tech

Work with the latest hardware and software so you're always set up to succeed.




Ideas Welcome, Always

We don’t just say we’re open to ideas—we act on them. Your insights can shape how we work across the company.




Fast, Agile, Adaptive

We move like a start-up but with the backing of a larger team. Quick decisions and a responsive culture are the norm.




Incredible Team, Global Reach

Join an international crew of 175+ passionate, talented people. We hire for skill, drive, and authenticity—just be yourself.




APPLICATION




Please include a cover letter with your application. It does not need to be long, but it should give us clear evidence of how you work.




In your cover letter, please briefly cover:




one example of a messy workflow, process, or system you helped make clearer, including what changed and what improved;
your experience with Airtable or similar lightweight project/workflow tools, including what you have built or improved;
one practical example of how you use AI in your work, including how you check or apply the output.




RECRUITMENT PROCESS




First, we will review your CV and cover letter for the requested examples.




If successful, you will receive a task using a provided Airtable base. We will ask you to show how you structure the workflow, build useful views or interfaces, document your decisions, and explain your approach.




If successful, you will be invited to a 60-minute interview. During the meeting, you will walk through your completed task as if presenting to a client, followed by a Q&A with Creative Operations management.




And that’s it!

description:
About the job

Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide! Vonage Communications APIs:

As an emerging leader in the $10B+ communications API market, we empower global brands to connect better with their customers, employees, and partners through transformative communications experiences. For example, Vonage API solutions empower organizations to build their custom omnichannel communications structure. This allows them to reach and engage customers on their preferred schedule and channel — including voice, video, and messaging. Think of a rideshare service instantly connecting with customers, hospital staff conducting remote monitoring, customers verifying their identity before completing a purchase, AI virtual agents servicing customers around the clock, and much more.

Why this role matters:

Our Customer Success Training Specialist will provide the foundational learning for our Customer Success teams. In this role you will be the architect of the CS journey, from the moment a new CSM joins to the mastery of our post-sales ecosystem.

Your key responsibilities:
End-to-End Onboarding: Design and lead a world-class onboarding program that gets new CSMs up to speed on our product, our customers, and our unique approach to partnership.
Continuous Enablement: Develop post-onboarding curricula that keep the team sharp on new feature releases, industry trends, and advanced account management strategies ; including expansion positioning from upselling and cross-selling 
Needs Assessment: Identify knowledge and skill gaps through data-driven assessments, aligning all training programs to revenue priorities and business objectives.
Blended Learning Delivery: Develop and deliver engaging learning experiences—including live workshops, virtual sessions, and eLearning—for global CS teams of all experience levels.
Tactical Content Creation: Build practical exercises, job aids, and visual guides that translate technical API capabilities and product updates into actionable "Success Plays."
Tools & Stack Mastery: Serve as the subject matter expert for the CS toolset (Gong, Salesforce andPlanhat,ensuring the team navigates our systems with speed and precision.
Strategic Partnership: Collaborate with CS Leadership to drive accountability and partner with Sales Enablement to ensure cohesive product and process updates across the revenue org.
Advocacy & Improvement: Serve as a trusted advisor and champion for continuous improvement in CS skills, processes, and training best practices.

 

What you’ll bring:

To be successful in this role, you should be a blend of an educator, a strategist, and a Customer Success advocate. We are looking for someone who understands that CS is both an art and a science. 

Required:

CS Enablement Background: 2–4 years of experience in Customer Success training and enablement. If you’ve previously carried a book of business as a CSM, that’s a major plus.
The "CS Lens" on Sales Process: A solid understanding of the B2B lifecycle. You understand how discovery, handoffs, and pipeline management directly impact long-term retention and expansion.
CS Tech Stack Power User: High proficiency in Salesforce and Planhat (or similar CS Platform such as Gainsight, Totango, Hubspot, Zendesk, and Churn Zero etc.). You are comfortable being the "go-to" expert who helps others navigate our tools with speed and precision.
Instructional Design Mastery: Experience creating clean, professional training materials, slide decks, and tutorials. Proficiency in Articulate (or similar authoring tools) is required to build our eLearning library.
Strong Facilitation Skills: You are a confident, engaging presenter who can break down complex API capabilities or process-heavy workflows into simple, actionable steps.

Experience we consider a plus:

Cross-Functional Collaborator: Ability to work effectively with Sales/CS Ops, Product Marketing, and CS Managers to ensure content is technically accurate and relevant to the field.
Detail-Oriented & Precise: A passion for accuracy and a "get it right" mindset when documenting internal processes and system workflows.
Strategic Advisor: A champion for continuous improvement who isn't afraid to identify skill gaps and propose creative solutions to fill them.
Methodology Knowledge: A background in MEDDPICC or similar sales/success methodologies is a significant advantage.
Where you will work:

This position offers a fully remote work arrangement based out of Mexico.

Sponsorship is not available. Legal authorization to work in Mexico is required. We are unable to sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. 

 

There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you.

To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice. 

Who we are:

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today.

description:
About the job

This role plays a key part in aligning strategic business initiatives with operational functions within the Customer Success organization at Teletrac Navman. As an Individual Contributor, the role drives high-priority strategic initiatives, delivers data-driven insights to improve revenue, retention and churn metrics, and builds scalable processes and tooling that enable the Customer Success team to deliver maximum value to customers. Success is measured by improvements in retention metrics, the quality of data and reporting available to leadership, and the effective implementation of process and technology improvements across the Customer Success function.




Key Responsibilities.

Drive high-priority strategic initiatives for the Customer Success team, proactively providing insights based on data and analysis to improve revenue, retention and churn metrics.
Build and maintain strategic relationships with business partners across the Customer Success organization.
Analyze data and collect insights to provide strategic recommendations to the broader team and business partners.
Own and deliver enablement initiatives for the Customer Success team, including bonus plan management.
Work closely with Customer Success leadership to implement scalable processes that improve client success.
Implement, document and enforce processes and tools that maintain data integrity, increase productivity and ultimately increase retention.
Partner with the Salesforce administrator to ensure the Customer Success team is properly trained in SFDC processes.
Own the implementation of new solutions for all stakeholders, driving process and system improvement.
Evaluate and implement improvements to Customer Success programmes including customer prioritization, account management and customer success risk management.
Manage automation, tools and reporting programmes, facilitating change to new processes and strategies set by leadership.
Ensure reports and dashboards are in place to provide leadership with the ability to make informed coaching, client and churn prediction decisions.
Analyze retention metrics, produce reports and maintain dashboards to support customer management.
Assist with strategic analysis including monitoring business KPIs, identifying emerging trends, developing forward-looking projections and providing insights on the drivers of customer health.
Work with Marketing to ensure content is available and leveraged effectively in onboarding, upgrade and retention processes.
Perform other duties and projects as required. 




WHO YOU ARE (Qualifications)

Relevant bachelor’s degree a plus.
5 years of demonstrated project management experience.
Proficiency in English with strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively at all levels.
Demonstrated expertise in project management, including planning, execution, and delivery of key initiatives.
Experience working with Artificial Intelligence technologies and applications.
Strong reporting and analytical skills, with the ability to produce clear, accurate, and actionable insights.
Salesforce (SFDC) experience required; intermediate or above Excel proficiency required. CPQ and PowerBi experience a plus.
Passion for designing processes that scale; ability to break down ambiguous problems into concrete, manageable components and think through optimal solutions.
High level of attention to detail; methodical and disciplined approach to problem-solving.
Demonstrated ability to operate both strategically and tactically; willingness to take ownership and be accountable for outcomes.
Ability to work within a fast-paced, change-embracing corporate culture and with a diverse, global team. 




Who Is Teletrac Navman

Teletrac Navman’s goal is to empower the industries that transform and sustain our futures with simple and intelligent solutions that enhance the efficiency, safety, and sustainability of their operation. As a connected mobility platform for industries that manage vehicle and equipment assets, Teletrac Navman simplifies the complex so that its customers can transform the way they work through cloud-based solutions that leverage AI to unlock the power of operational insight.

Teletrac Navman manages more than 700,000 vehicles and assets around the world. The company operates globally, with offices worldwide and headquarters in Northbrook IL. For more information visit teletracnavman.com. 

Teletrac Navman is a Vontier company.




Who Is Vontier

Vontier (NYSE: VNT) is a global technology company powering the way the world moves. We empower businesses in the transport sector to adapt to a fast-changing landscape by uniting productivity, automation and multi-energy technologies.

Our smart, connected solutions serve roadside convenience retail stores, fleet operators, and auto repair technicians. From integrated payments and EV charging software to carwash technology and retail automation, we help customers stay productive and prepared for a rapidly evolving industry.

With decades of expertise and a balanced portfolio, Vontier enables businesses to navigate complexity, unlock growth, and build a cleaner, safer future. Driven by continuous improvement and the dedication of Team Vontier, we empower businesses to think bigger, act boldly, and thrive on the road ahead. Learn more at www.vontier.com




At Vontier, we empower you to steer your career in the direction of success with a dynamic, innovative, and inclusive environment.




Our commitment to personal growth, work-life balance, and collaboration fuels a culture where your contributions drive meaningful change. We provide the roadmap for continuous learning, allowing creativity to flourish and ideas to accelerate into impactful solutions that contribute to a sustainable future.

Join our community of passionate people working together to navigate challenges and seize new opportunities. At Vontier, you are not on this journey alone, we are committed to equipping you with the tools and support you need to fuel your innovation, lead with impact, and thrive both personally and professionally.




Together, let’s power the way the world moves!

description:
About the job

Join the wave of growth at Maersk! We're not just a company, we're a movement. With a vision larger than the ocean, we're on a mission to connect and simplify our customers' supply chains as a true integrator of container logistics. And we need talented individuals like you to make it happen!

2 years of growth, and we're just getting started! Our Global Service Center (GSC) in Mexico has been thriving, and we're taking it to the next level. As part of our GSC Americas team, you'll be at the forefront of driving excellence across our global network, collaborating with diverse professionals, and embracing challenges that inspire growth. If you're ready to propel your career with a world leader in transport and logistics, Maersk is your destination. Embark on a journey with us—where your passion will navigate the future of global commerce.

Here’s the Deal

The Container Sales Customer Experience team manages a team involved in the outfleet of old and total loss containers, selling them globally in over 70 countries. Responsibilities include handling after-sales activities, ensuring compliance with regulations, managing financial transactions, and addressing customer queries. The role requires seamless communication and coordination with stakeholders, training new joiners, driving process improvements and participating in business reviews. Strong analytical skills for handling large datasets and continuous self-development, especially in learning new technologies like Microsoft tools, are essential for success.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Focus & Stakeholder Support


Deliver friendly and professional customer service to internal and external stakeholders.
Respond to customer inquiries via email, phone, or chat, ensuring timely and accurate resolution.
Support the maintenance and updating of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) in collaboration with the compliance team.
Assist in identifying areas for improving customer experience and service quality.
Participate in customer onboarding and implementation support activities.
Join regular calls with customers and internal teams to review service performance and gather feedback.


Data Awareness & Reporting


Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and service requests.
Assist in preparing basic reports and summaries using Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Learn to work with customer data to identify common issues and suggest improvements.
Exposure to tools like Power BI, Power Automate, and SQL is a plus, but not mandatory.


Team Collaboration


Work closely with team members to ensure smooth service delivery.
Share learnings and best practices with peers.
Participate in team meetings and engagement activities.


Operational Support


Support after-sales processes related to container delivery and order fulfillment.
Coordinate with depots and terminals to track and follow up on container movements.
Help resolve basic issues related to delays or documentation.
Escalate process improvement ideas to the relevant teams.

We offer customers thousands of popular movies and TV shows including Amazon Originals and exclusive licensed content to exciting live sports events. We also offer our members the opportunity to subscribe to add-on channels which they can cancel at any time and to rent or buy new release movies. Prime Video is a fast-paced, growth business - available in over 240 countries and territories worldwide. The team works in a dynamic environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do. If this sounds exciting to you, please read on. The Prime Video International marketing team is looking for a highly motivated, innovative and performance-oriented Brand Manager to help grow our Global Originals business across Europe, Latin America and Canada. The role will focus on marketing strategies and campaigns for Prime Video’s Global Original slate similar to the likes of The Summer I Turned Pretty, Off Campus, We Were Liars, amongst others. This role will involve planning, producing and executing large marketing campaigns with complex cross-functional teams. You will negotiate with key business partners and global teams to gain alignment on marketing plans, and ultimately manage all aspects of the project execution across international locales.

Key job responsibilities


 Manage end-to-end marketing campaigns for Global Originals from strategy through to execution, reporting and analysis across multiple countries in EU/LATAM/Canada.
 Lead and brief key teams on the development and delivery of International marketing assets across Production, Amazon owned platforms, Ads, Social, Creators and ATL paid media channels.
 Manage relationships with internal stakeholders including leadership, studios, content teams, marketing and PR to align on International campaign priorities and creative direction.
 Be comfortable presenting to a wide-range of partners from documents to decks, often with frequent updates to internal and external audiences.

 Manage blocking issues, provide escalation management, anticipate and make trade-offs, and meet committed delivery timelines.
 Report on International campaign learnings to continuously refine your approach and raise the creative bar.


Basic Qualifications


 5+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
 Experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements
 Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional programs or marketing campaigns from concept to completion
 Experience with strong project management skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment
 Experience in written and oral communication, including the ability to communicate with all levels in the organization (technical, business, executive)
 Experience demonstrating strong analytical abilities and confidence in the use of data
 Speak, write, and read fluently in English
 Proven track record of developing and executing on time and within budget.
 Ability to think strategically across marketing plans, talent and creative, delivering the day to day while simultaneously defining and leading future direction.
 Experience working with large cross-functional teams (e.g. Product, Synergy, Ads, PR, Social) and external partners, including creative agencies and production.


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience creating brand marketing content
 Experience using customer research, hard data and metrics to back up assumptions, generate forecasts, and assess the efficacy of marketing programs
 Significant experience delivering integrated, audience demo-led marketing campaigns for entertainment properties or original productions.
 Professional experience in content capture environments (on-set, marketing days, press junkets) and a strong eye for platform-optimised asset creation.

description:
About the job

Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

Are you looking for a Digital Specialist role that allows you to enhance marketing strategy and shape creative solutions? If so, this Digital Marketing Manager role could be an excellent opportunity to consider.

As a Digital Marketing Manager, you will lead an integrated set of digital, multi-channel marketing functions to rapidly and efficiently respond to business needs.

This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:


Monitor the external digital landscape in the pharmaceutical industry evaluating new trends and crafting a long-term vision for the company
Provide inputs to stakeholders on Multi-Channel (MC) initiatives including comparing/contrasting company MC vision with competitors and mobilizing stakeholders to take necessary actions, trainings and plans
Identify MC opportunities for each brand giving inputs to MC Area Management and generating best practices for Local Operating Company (LOC).
Evaluate the macro and micro environment and develop interpretations and vision for MC as part of marketing mix
Coach brand managers and generate best practice MC programs focusing on the global MC priorities
Develop ways of working, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and capability trainings for Multi-Channel Marketing (MCM)
Leverage MC analytics and performance measurement by monitoring monthly MC performance figures
Define lead and lag Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and set MC targets for tracking performance vs target
Routinely communicate MC performance outcomes with marketers and support them based on outcomes 
Align with the global team members on performance KPIs and analyze Return on Investment (ROI) calculation



Why you?

Basic Qualifications:

We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:


Bachelor’s degree
3 years of experience in business intelligence or insights
3 years of experience in digital marketing
Project management experience in a commercial setting



Preferred Qualifications:

If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:


MBA
Deep understanding of multi-channel marketing strategies
Ability to influence without authority
Strong verbal and written communication skills



Why Haleon?

Our Win as One Framework is a simple, stretching definition of our future direction. It includes our purpose, ambitions, strategic drivers, and behaviours that will enable us to Win as One. This framework guides our decision-making, strategy, and culture. The successful candidate will demonstrate the following capabilities:


Consumer first, always: Engage key business counterparts and operational stakeholders to deliver operational execution of Haleon strategies related to eCommerce activities, always putting the consumer first.
Collaborate for impact: Establish and maintain relationships with critical groups to ensure customer knowledge is utilized to inform and deliver on the eCommerce roadmap, collaborating for impact.
Unlock value, at pace: Drive business process improvement throughout the commercial and operational support teams, unlocking value at pace.
Grow myself and others: Continuously look for opportunities to learn, build skills, and share learning, growing myself and others.



Job Posting End Date

2026-08-24

Equal Opportunities

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.

During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.

The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

Adjustment or Accommodations Request

If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.

Note to candidates

The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

title: Senior Designer & Team Lead for Marketing Agency [435]
skills: Demonstrated ability to personally produce high-performing static and simple motion ads for paid digital campaigns, with speed and consistency.
Strong portfolio of direct-response ad creative, ideally showing work built from client-provided assets (performance ads matter more than brand campaigns).
Experience developing creative that drives performance metrics such as CTR, ROAS, conversions, and customer acquisition.
Experience mentoring or managing designers in a remote setting, giving effective creative feedback, and improving team processes.
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and related design tools, with an efficient, template-smart workflow.
Highly self-directed, with strong communication and organizational skills and the confidence to own your workload in a fully remote environment.
Strong English speaking and writing skills.
A genuine personal interest in tabletop gaming.
Familiarity with gaming culture more broadly, including Kickstarter launches, conventions, and the communities around them.
Experience designing for niche or enthusiast audiences.
Creative writing abilities to take general concepts and add compelling copy

Personally design and produce static and simple motion ad-creative for paid social and digital platforms, working from account manager briefs and client-provided assets (our account managers own both the brief and the ad copy, so you can focus entirely on visual craft and execution).
Deliver work reliably on quick timelines that support ongoing creative testing and iteration.
Develop and document creative best practices, design standards, templates, and workflows that make the whole team faster and more consistent.
Lead, mentor, and develop a small remote creative team of 3-4 designers: assign work, balance bandwidth, give constructive design feedback, and support each designer’s professional growth.
Review team deliverables for quality, brand alignment, and performance potential.
Collaborate closely with account management, media buying, and leadership to keep creative aligned with campaign goals and performance objectives.
Communicate proactively with leadership regarding project status, resourcing needs, risks, and opportunities.
Stay current on paid social creative best practices, platform requirements, and trends within gaming and tabletop communities.
Opportunity to grow and develop the creative team as the agency scales.
Fully remote work environment.
A chance to define how creative gets made at a growing agency.
Direct exposure to a fast-moving, performance-driven creative team.
description:
About the job

About the Company:

Wayfinder Agency is the #1 digital marketing agency for tabletop game companies, a fully remote team of marketers, media buyers, and creatives who help incredible games reach players around the world. Our campaigns have generated millions in Kickstarter pledges and eCommerce revenue for brands like Ravensburger, Roll20, Paizo, and Pandasaurus. We’re not your typical agency: we move fast, think creatively, and care deeply about performance. We operate with a lean, collaborative culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership, and if you love strategy, data, and working with passionate creative teams, you’ll fit right in. 




About the Role:

We’re hiring a hands-on Senior Designer & Team Lead who will personally produce high-performing static and motion ads for paid digital campaigns every week, while also mentoring and developing a small remote creative team of 3-4 designers. This role is both a working creative seat and a leadership seat: you’ll build the templates, best practices, and workflows the team runs on, stay close to real performance data, and help define how creative gets made at a growing agency. A genuine passion for tabletop games and gaming culture is a major plus.




This role is a Full-Time remote position.




We are looking for a Senior Designer & Team Lead specifically with these requirements:

Demonstrated ability to personally produce high-performing static and simple motion ads for paid digital campaigns, with speed and consistency.
Strong portfolio of direct-response ad creative, ideally showing work built from client-provided assets (performance ads matter more than brand campaigns).
Experience developing creative that drives performance metrics such as CTR, ROAS, conversions, and customer acquisition.
Experience mentoring or managing designers in a remote setting, giving effective creative feedback, and improving team processes.
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and related design tools, with an efficient, template-smart workflow.
Highly self-directed, with strong communication and organizational skills and the confidence to own your workload in a fully remote environment.
Strong English speaking and writing skills.




Nice to Haves:

A genuine personal interest in tabletop gaming. 
Familiarity with gaming culture more broadly, including Kickstarter launches, conventions, and the communities around them.
Experience designing for niche or enthusiast audiences.
Creative writing abilities to take general concepts and add compelling copy




Your responsibility will include (but not limited to):

Personally design and produce static and simple motion ad-creative for paid social and digital platforms, working from account manager briefs and client-provided assets (our account managers own both the brief and the ad copy, so you can focus entirely on visual craft and execution).
Deliver work reliably on quick timelines that support ongoing creative testing and iteration.
Develop and document creative best practices, design standards, templates, and workflows that make the whole team faster and more consistent.
Lead, mentor, and develop a small remote creative team of 3-4 designers: assign work, balance bandwidth, give constructive design feedback, and support each designer’s professional growth.
Review team deliverables for quality, brand alignment, and performance potential.
Collaborate closely with account management, media buying, and leadership to keep creative aligned with campaign goals and performance objectives.
Communicate proactively with leadership regarding project status, resourcing needs, risks, and opportunities.
Stay current on paid social creative best practices, platform requirements, and trends within gaming and tabletop communities.




Growth Opportunities/Perks:

Opportunity to grow and develop the creative team as the agency scales.
Fully remote work environment.
A chance to define how creative gets made at a growing agency.
Direct exposure to a fast-moving, performance-driven creative team.




You’re a Great Fit for This Role If…

 ✅ You know what high-performing paid social creative looks like and can produce it yourself.

 ✅ You care about measurable outcomes such as CTR, conversions, and ROAS-not just visual quality.

 ✅ You work quickly, stay organized, and can turn limited client-provided assets into effective ads.

 ✅ You enjoy mentoring designers, giving clear feedback, and helping a creative team improve.

 ✅ You communicate proactively and thrive in a fast-moving, remote agency environment.




Our hiring process is made up of four parts, so please be aware that you will need to dedicate time for a questionnaire, a video, and two 1-on-1 interviews.




Thank you for taking the time to consider this position. We look forward to hearing from you soon!

This is a senior, hands-on role for a designer who can both set creative direction and execute at a high standard across digital, video, and event formats. There is room for everyone! We empower each other to innovate and create processes that use technology to generate meaningful, lasting change. Collaborate with marketing, sales, product, and executive leadership to translate business goals into compelling creative solutions
Bring fresh ideas, design trends, AI-powered creative workflows, and new storytelling approaches that help Visit.org stand out in the CSR and employee engagement market


Requirements


4 to 7 years of experience in graphic design, brand design, or creative roles, with a track record of leading creative work from concept through delivery
Strong portfolio demonstrating campaign-level creative work across digital marketing, social media, presentations, and video (portfolio required with application)
Fluent professional English, written and spoken; this role works daily with a US-based team and creates content for US-market audiences
Expert proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects) and modern design tools such as Figma and Canva
Experience building and maintaining brand systems, including visual identity guidelines, templates, and asset libraries that scale across teams
Strong video editing and motion design skills, with experience producing content for social, marketing, and events
Experience adopting AI-powered creative tools and workflows to increase output quality and speed
Strong editorial instincts: you notice weak headlines and clunky copy, and you can improve them
Proven ability to partner with senior stakeholders and translate business objectives into creative direction
Highly organized and self-directed, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and deadlines independently, with minimal supervision
Experience working with B2B, SaaS, or mission-driven brands is a plus
Experience working in a fast-paced startup environment
Passion for our mission and the desire to make an impact in the world through technology

Passion for our mission and the desire to make an impact in the world through technology


Please note: This is a remote, Mexico-based 40 hr/week contract position that requires working hours from 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM EST

About the job

About Manifest

Manifest is a tech-enabled immigration law firm reshaping how legal services are delivered. Our mission is to make the immigration process faster, smarter, and more accessible for millions of people navigating one of life's most complex systems. Traditional immigration law is built on opacity, billable hours, and outdated communication. Manifest is different. We combine top-tier legal talent with modern technology to create a transparent, efficient, human-centered experience—and a trusted platform that enterprises rely on for critical, global workforce decisions. We're not building a better firm. We're redefining what a modern legal services platform can be.

About The Team

You'll join a tight-knit revenue team that treats sales like product development — constantly iterating on our advisory methodology to better serve clients navigating complex immigration decisions. We act as trusted advisors, not closers, helping clients understand their options with genuine expertise. We work closely with Legal, Marketing, and Product, and we care deeply about transforming how people experience immigration services.

What You'll Do

This role owns net-new revenue for Manifest's talent immigration clients. Day to day, you will:


Engage founders, engineers, and individuals navigating the immigration system to diagnose needs, map requirements, and architect solutions
Build trust-based relationships with prospective clients alongside Marketing, Product, and Operations — the decision to hire an immigration attorney is a serious one
Plan and manage accounts with structured discipline across complex customer groups


What We're Looking For


1+ years of SDR, sales, or client-facing experience
Background engaging individuals around complex, high-consideration decisions — legal, financial, healthcare, or similar
Confident leading high-stakes, high-trust conversations
Strong EQ and a natural ability to build relationships across a range of people
Organized and methodical, with the ability to run cross-functional programs end-to-end


This is for you if...

You're energized by relationships over pipelines, equally comfortable thinking strategically and executing tactically, and motivated by building something new rather than selling something established.

This is not for you if...

You're uncomfortable with accountability, high-stakes conversations, or the emotional weight of guiding people through life-changing decisions — and you're not driven to hit aggressive revenue targets while doing it.

We’re a highly-technical, passionate, and driven team. We are more than 90 people and our team currently represents 20 nationalities. We have offices in São Paulo and Mexico City – while a large portion of us work remotely.

El Project Manager coordina todas las fases del proyecto, trabajando estrechamente con el cliente para asegurarse de que la tecnología se adapte a sus necesidades y que se utilice de manera eficiente para obtener el máximo valor. Es responsable de la gestión del ciclo de vida del proyecto, desde su inicio hasta el análisis de impacto y la identificación de nuevas necesidades o proyectos adicionales.




Responsabilidades principales

Gestión del ciclo completo del proyecto: Coordinar todas las fases del proyecto, incluyendo la alta del cliente, la formación, la demostración de valor y el análisis del impacto.
Formación de clientes: Asegurar que el cliente reciba la formación adecuada según su ritmo de aprendizaje, cubriendo tanto la operativa básica como los usos avanzados de la tecnología.
Demostración de valor: Mostrar cómo la tecnología de imágenes satelitales está impactando positivamente en los resultados del cliente, haciendo énfasis en los beneficios específicos para su negocio.
Análisis de impacto: Evaluar cómo la implementación de la tecnología ha mejorado los procesos y resultados del cliente, buscando áreas de mejora continua.
Identificación de necesidades adicionales: Detectar oportunidades para nuevos proyectos o necesidades que el cliente pueda tener, alimentando el ciclo de ventas con información relevante.
Relación con clientes: Garantizar la satisfacción y fidelización del cliente, convirtiéndose en su punto de contacto principal para cualquier consulta o mejora.
Adaptación a las necesidades del cliente: Trabajar estrechamente con los clientes para personalizar la implementación y adaptarla a sus procesos, asegurando que aprovechen todas las capacidades de la tecnología.
Colaboración interna: Coordinarse con el equipo técnico, incluyendo al Técnico de Agricultura de Precisión, para resolver problemas y asegurar que la implementación sea exitosa.
Realizar visitas periódicas a clientes y desplazarse a diferentes regiones de México para dar seguimiento a los proyectos, impartir capacitaciones y asegurar el éxito de las implementaciones.




Habilidades y conocimientos necesarios

Gestión de proyectos: Capacidad para coordinar proyectos complejos y garantizar la entrega en tiempo y forma.
Capacidad de comunicación y liderazgo: Habilidad para dirigir al equipo interno y trabajar con clientes, asegurando que todos los involucrados estén alineados.
Conocimiento del sector agrícola: Familiaridad con los procesos agrícolas, especialmente en caña de azúcar, arroz y cereales, para adaptar las soluciones de NAX a las necesidades del cliente.
Enfoque en resultados y satisfacción del cliente: Habilidad para retener clientes y maximizar el valor que perciben de la solución a lo largo del tiempo.
Capacidad de adaptación: Ajustar el enfoque de trabajo según el ritmo de aprendizaje del cliente y sus necesidades específicas.
Disponibilidad para viajar de manera frecuente dentro de México y contar con licencia de conducir vigente (deseable).
